sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'
SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.LastEditorUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'
SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.Age > 65 AND T1.Score > 19
SELECT T2.Body FROM tags AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.ExcerptPostId WHERE T1.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.Score) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age > 65, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5
SELECT T2.FavoriteCount FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 3025 AND T1.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT IIF(T2.ClosedDate IS NULL, 'NOT well-finished', 'well-finished') AS result FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 23853 AND T1.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Id = 6347
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24
SELECT ViewCount FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'thank you user93!'
SELECT T2.DisplayName, T2.Reputation FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?'
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?'
SELECT T1.Comment FROM postHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
SELECT T3.DisplayName, T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND T1.Title LIKE '%variance%'
SELECT AVG(T2.ViewCount), T2.Title, T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.PostId WHERE T2.Tags = '<humor>' GROUP BY T2.Title, T1.Text
SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM (SELECT UserId, COUNT(Name) AS num FROM badges GROUP BY UserId) WHERE num > 5

SELECT T1.Id FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T3.ViewCount >= 1000 GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PostHistoryTypeId) = 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) - CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student'
SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011', 1, 0)) FROM votes
SELECT T2.Id FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'slashnick' ORDER BY T2.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder') GROUP BY T1.DisplayName ORDER BY SUM(T2.ViewCount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.Tags FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND T2.CommentCount = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T3.TagName = 'r', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN tags AS T3 ON T3.ExcerptPostId = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Community'
SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Mornington', T2.ViewCount, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Amos', T2.ViewCount, 0)) AS diff FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Id) AS REAL) / 12 FROM postLinks AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.AnswerCount <= 2 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2010'
SELECT T2.CreationDate FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'chl' ORDER BY T2.CreationDate LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Name = 'Autobiographer' ORDER BY T2.Date LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND T2.FavoriteCount >= 4
SELECT T2.Id, T2.Title FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' ORDER BY T2.ViewCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.Id, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2010' ORDER BY T2.FavoriteCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Reputation > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.LastAccessDate) = '2011'
SELECT T1.ViewCount, T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.LastEditorUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Computer Game Datasets'
SELECT COUNT(T2.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Id = (SELECT Id FROM posts ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT T3.Text, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY T3.CreationDate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Score > 50, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
SELECT ExcerptPostId, WikiPostId FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'sample'
SELECT T2.Reputation, T2.UpVotes FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'fine, you win :)'
SELECT T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150 ORDER BY T1.Score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CommentCount = 1 AND T1.Score = 0
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.UpVotes = 0, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND cardKingdomId IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'gladiator' AND T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.rarity = 'mythic'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.status FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.type = 'Artifact' AND T2.format = 'vintage' AND T1.side IS NULL
